{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental changes to CMakeLists.txt and Guix codesign scripts follow from the backported commits rather than addressing build system problems.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "The PR contains no substantive build or CI changes; Guix and CMake edits are incidental to the backport bundle."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Backports commits that explicitly reframe private broadcast privacy guarantees and update related documentation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Clarifies documentation to prevent users from relying on overstated origin concealment guarantees for private transaction broadcast. Commits bfc87b96ef and fa11293ddc reframe claims 'in terms of risk reduction rather than absolutes' and mark the feature experimental."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes the private transaction broadcast feature's operational status and documentation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Marks the -privatebroadcast feature as experimental and softens origin concealment privacy claims. This ensures node operators understand the limits of transaction origin privacy protections on the network."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc files to correct OpenRPC argument metadata and schema generation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects argument metadata producing invalid or misleading OpenRPC defaults across RPC methods. Commit 7a0964a252 fixes issues like the 'send include_watching option' having a string default that makes the generated schema inconsistent."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Functional test changes (feature_torcontrol.py, wallet_backwards_compatibility.py) test specific backported behavior rather than test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes to test scripts support the wallet and p2p backports rather than altering the test framework or harnesses."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Man page regenerations and script touches do not alter developer or deployment tooling logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No core developer tools or operational scripts are modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touch to src/init.cpp merely sets arguments for the private broadcast feature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to startup logic in init.cpp serve the private broadcast feature rather than shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Optimizes descriptor string comparisons across walletdescriptor lookups in src/wallet/walletutil.* and descriptor handling.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Caches and compares SHA-256 hashes of canonical descriptor strings to eliminate slow repeated recomputations in HasWalletDescriptor. Commit 7fdb8584da notes canonical string comparisons were slow because they recomputed the canonical string for each comparison."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
